notes.title: Upcoming - 1.1 Update
notes.content:
It has been almost a year that Crash The Core has been out and I have heard the community loud and clear on what you want changed and I happen to agree with almost everything you have been saying so an update is coming! Here are some of the systems that are going to be reworked:

[h3]Reworks[/h3]
[b][list]
[*] Battle GUI Rework
[*] Card Selection GUI Rework
[*] Enemy Balance Rework
[*] Events Rework
[*] Accessories Rework
[*] Settings Rework
[/list][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877059/e34e0e08df3d5bf4aeb8b8f830210080a2668144.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877059/ef70211626b53e9d683d0bab8036d7c2d1c852ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877059/5d246a2ea8bea975f574ec981161bac874e25254.png[/img]

There are also bugs and smaller features that I have added to improve the overall life of the game so thank you to everyone who has left comments and let me know what features matter to you almost all of them have been added.

There will also be a lot more enemies and card variety with new content added. I will talk about the specifics of that during the release of the update.

I posted this to ask what kind of things you would be looking for, expect, or would want in a 1.1 update of Crash The Core. Let me know in the comments or on Discord.

Thanks so much!

- Jerome

tags.feature: There will also be a lot more enemies and card variety with new content added.

notes.title: Crash The Core - New Tooltips, Menu and Balance Changes Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Tooltips, Menu and Balance Changes Update 1.0.5[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a Bug where Settings would not save properly on restart
[*] New 4K (3840x2160) Screen Resolution Added
[*] You can now use the mouse wheel to scroll through menus
[*] Reduced Damage of Enemies that did Double Attacks
[*] Reduced The Effect of Power Ups for Some Enemies
[*] Fixed a Bug where Weapon Power is not increased with ring
[*] Some UI Elements Visually Improved
[*] Added Tooltips to the Map
[*] Added Tooltips After Enemy Battles
[*] Fixed a Bug where the Weapon Menu would crash when replacing Weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Crash The Core - Bug Squashing Patch Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2][b]Crash The Core - Bug Squashing Patch Update 1.0.4[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a Bug where you would draw a ‘Strike’ card each turn
[*] Fixed a Bug were tutorial tooltips would sometimes still be active during Missions
[*] Fixed Bug where ‘Chaos Portal’ summoned more than 5 Gadgets
[*] Fixed a Bug were Starter Gadgets occasionally had the wrong Durability/Cost on the card
[*] Fixed a Bug were Starter Summons would return to your deck before being destroyed/salvage
[*] Fixed a Bug were ‘Energy Converter’ did not expose the player’
[*] Changed Energy Axe so it Now Gives you 1 Energy Next turn goes 30 Damage and cost 2 Energy
[*] ‘Galaxy Pull’ Energy cost reduced from 5 to 3
[*] ‘Scrapy Guard’ changed to ‘Scrapy Shield’ and now has a per turn draw limit
[*] Fixed a Bug where the game would crash while buying accessories during co-op
[/list]
Also, I wanted to say thank you for all the amazing support, bug reports, and kind reviews. I am very fortunate to have such a great player base!

notes.title: Crash The Core - Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Crash The Core - Small Patch and Update 1.0.3[/b][/h1]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed Crash When loaded saves with Accessories
[*] Long Neck Now Affects Both Red Starter and Blue Summons
[*] Fixed Bug where Final Boss ‘Sol’ did not Gain Power on 2nd and 3rd Turns
[/list]
Added Achievement
[list]
[*] Added the ‘Core Helmet’ for Level 6 Prestige
[/list]
Card Changes
[list]
[*] Forest Spirit - Stats Buffed 10/10 to 20/40 and new Passive “Whenever you Salvage a card, Block 10 Damage.”
[*] Long Neck - Buffed 30 to 40 Shield
[*] Screwdriver - Item 2 to 3 Durability
[*] Repair - Gained +2 Durability instead of doubling
[*] Destroy - Damage reduced 150 to 140
[*] Snowky Yak - Change to 30 Attack and 30 Shield
[/list]

notes.title: The First Update on Nov 28, 2021! - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Crash The Core - The First Update! Update 1.0.1
[list]
[*] Fixed Event choice bug that leads to unlimited enemy skips
[*] Fixed bug where Player 2 Specialty Salvaging would default to conductor
[*] Starter Cards Hover Tooltips have been added to reflect card text
[*] Consumables added text description
[*] Consumables Hover Tooltips have to Added to reflect card text
[*] Specialty Upgrading explained More clearly.
[*] Weapon Damage Salvaging is shown to the player when used 
[*] Azure Champion Draw effect will activate when it defends.
[*] Removed a bug that made Poison damage inconsistent
[*] Voice Lines that did not belong to certain characters were removed.
[*] The amount of Sabotage Cards an Enemy adds to your deck has been reduced.
[/list]

Also Happy Birthday to Simon ːsteamhappyː He helped me design the game and inspires me every day to be a better game designer and person.
